verdict.rationale: New Relic AI lets users ask questions and explore telemetry in plain language, and can help fix queries that aren't working (docs-9, docs-10). The official MCP server converts plain-English questions into NRQL and returns results (docs-22), and NRQL is the language that drives charts (docs-3, docs-32). Missing for 10: no explicit evidence that a natural-language question returns a rendered chart (as opposed to a query or results), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of NL-to-NRQL accuracy.
